audit_status.source_base: ChatGPT-authored Psalms completion draft using public-domain KJV as familiar alignment scaffold with curated Hebrew/textual overrides; full WLC/OSHB/source-witness audit pending
audit_status.review_note: Royal oracle, YHWH/adoni distinction, enemies, priesthood, Melchizedek, and later messianic reception.

verses.restored: YHWH says to my lord [adoni], “Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.”

familiar.text: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.

notes.title: YHWH and adoni
notes.body: The Hebrew distinguishes the divine name YHWH from adoni, “my lord/master.” The verse became central in later Jewish and Christian interpretation; the restored wording preserves the Hebrew distinction instead of collapsing both figures into the same title.

modern.text: The LORD said to my Lord: “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”

original.text: לְדָוִ֗ד מִ֫זְמ֥וֹר נְאֻ֤ם יְהוָ֨ה לַֽאדֹנִ֗י שֵׁ֥ב לִֽימִינִ֑י עַד אָשִׁ֥ית אֹ֝יְבֶ֗יךָ הֲדֹ֣ם לְרַגְלֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: YHWH shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.

familiar.text: The LORD shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.

modern.text: The LORD extends Your mighty scepter from Zion: “Rule in the midst of Your enemies.”

original.text: מַטֵּֽה עֻזְּךָ֗ יִשְׁלַ֣ח יְ֭הוָה מִצִּיּ֑וֹן רְ֝דֵ֗ה בְּקֶ֣רֶב אֹיְבֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.

familiar.text: Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.

modern.text: Your people shall be willing on Your day of battle. Arrayed in holy splendor, from the womb of the dawn, to You belongs the dew of Your youth.

original.text: עַמְּךָ֣ נְדָבֹת֮ בְּי֪וֹם חֵ֫ילֶ֥ךָ בְּֽהַדְרֵי קֹ֭דֶשׁ מֵרֶ֣חֶם מִשְׁחָ֑ר לְ֝ךָ֗ טַ֣ל יַלְדֻתֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: YHWH has sworn and will not relent: “You are a priest forever, according to the order [or manner] of Melchizedek.”

familiar.text: The LORD hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.

notes.title: Melchizedek
notes.body: The Hebrew phrase al-divrati Malki-Tzedek is difficult and has generated multiple interpretations. Hebrews 5–7 later develops a major priestly reading. The source ambiguity and later reception should remain distinct.

modern.text: The LORD has sworn and will not change His mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”

original.text: נִשְׁבַּ֤ע יְהוָ֨ה וְלֹ֥א יִנָּחֵ֗ם אַתָּֽה כֹהֵ֥ן לְעוֹלָ֑ם עַל דִּ֝בְרָתִ֗י מַלְכִּי צֶֽדֶק

verses.restored: The Lord at thy right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.

familiar.text: The Lord at thy right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.

modern.text: The Lord is at Your right hand; He will crush kings in the day of His wrath.

original.text: אֲדֹנָ֥י עַל יְמִֽינְךָ֑ מָחַ֖ץ בְּיוֹם אַפּ֣וֹ מְלָכִֽים

verses.restored: He shall judge among the nations, he shall fill the places with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.

familiar.text: He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill the places with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.

modern.text: He will judge the nations, heaping up the dead; He will crush the leaders far and wide.

original.text: יָדִ֣ין בַּ֭גּוֹיִם מָלֵ֣א גְוִיּ֑וֹת מָ֥חַץ רֹ֝֗אשׁ עַל אֶ֥רֶץ רַבָּֽה

verses.restored: He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.

familiar.text: He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.

modern.text: He will drink from the brook by the road; therefore He will lift up His head.

original.text: מִ֭נַּחַל בַּדֶּ֣רֶךְ יִשְׁתֶּ֑ה עַל כֵּ֝֗ן יָרִ֥ים רֹֽאשׁ

translation_notes: This chapter completes corpus coverage as a ChatGPT-authored draft. KJV is retained as a familiar comparison layer; a separate automated reference pass adds BSB and pointed Hebrew without replacing the restored draft.
safety_note: Royal-priestly imagery must not create leader immunity or sacred violence; later Christian readings should not erase the Hebrew psalm or Jewish interpretation.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Psalms witnesses where extant, and other textual witnesses during the global audit. Preserve poetic parallelism, superscriptions, acrostic structure, duplicate/reused psalms, and significant Hebrew/Greek divergences rather than harmonizing them.
